description: This file defines the GeneratorAdapterFactory class, which implements various interfaces related to stream generation in Orleans. It manages configuration, creation of receivers, queue caches, and monitors for a stream generator provider, facilitating configurable stream event generation without reading from storage.

classes.name: GeneratorAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory and adapter class for stream generation, managing queue adapters, configuration, monitors, and receivers.

classes.name: Receiver
classes.description: Inner class representing a receiver that generates stream messages using a configured stream generator.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal collections and configuration, setting up monitor factories and loading generator configuration.

methods.name: CreateBufferPoolIfNotCreatedYet
methods.description: Creates a buffer pool for stream message batching if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Returns the current instance as a task result to conform to factory interface.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the current factory instance as the cache.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Provides a stream queue mapper, lazily instantiated as a hash ring based mapper.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a failure handler, defaulting to a no-op implementation.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Stub method for batching message queue operations; currently does nothing.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a receiver for a specified queue, attaching a stream generator if configured.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Sets the generator configuration and updates all receivers with the new generator.

methods.name: SetGeneratorOnReceiver
methods.description: Configures a stream generator for a receiver based on the current generator configuration.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue, initializing buffers and monitors.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate and initialize a GeneratorAdapterFactory.
